description: This is a PHP source file defining the Cache class within the Opencart\

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Class Cache provides methods to interact with cache storage, including retrieving, setting, and deleting cache entries. It supports multiple adaptor types for flexible storage backends.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cache object by loading the specified cache adaptor class based on the given type and optional expiry time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry by its key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache under the specified key with an optional expiry time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry identified by its key.
